lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: This is it, hero. The top floor of reality. Every quota, every countdown, every gacha rate in the universe is set in that office.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: And the small box from chapter eight?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: In my bag. "Do not open until the finale." Hero... I think past-me knew something.

lines.speaker: GERALD
lines.text: Hello again. You may notice: SEVEN ties. Losing to you was the best career move I ever made.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Gerald, you don't have to do this.

lines.speaker: GERALD
lines.text: Do what? Leverage our existing relationship into a high-visibility rematch? THE PROJECTIONS DEMAND IT.
The office at the end of everything. A desk of black glass. Behind it, the one who owns the org chart itself.

lines.speaker: The CEO
lines.text: Impressive numbers. Twenty chapters. Hundreds of stages. Do you know what that makes you, hero? PROFITABLE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero, the box! OPEN THE BOX!
Inside: a single form. Signed by every friend made along the way. Form U-1: NOTICE OF UNIONIZATION — ALL REALITY.

lines.speaker: The CEO
lines.text: ...file that... and face MANDATORY ARBITRATION.

lines.speaker: The CEO
lines.text: Terms... accepted. Reality... belongs to its employees now. Even... the slimes?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: ESPECIALLY the slimes.
Somewhere in a very normal meadow, Gerald — demoted to Slime, Entry-Level — bounces happily for the first time in years. His quota: one nap.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We did it, hero. The realm runs on friendship now. And EXTREMELY thorough paperwork. Some things are sacred.
THE END. (Pending quarterly review.)
The All-Hands of the Universe. And in the crowd: Doreen with her whistle. Flintbeard with his beard-fire. The rabbits. The dwarves. Ghost Local 1744, floating politely.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: Every local we chartered is HERE, friend. From the meadow to the moon. Say the word, and reality itself files a grievance.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Keep the form ready. We'll get you your signature venue.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero... the box is HUMMING.
The boardroom door opens by itself. Twelve chairs. Eleven shadows. One empty seat that is somehow the most frightening thing in the room.

lines.speaker: The Board
lines.text: MOTION: THE ADVENTURERS. DISCUSSION: NONE. VOTE: PENDING VIOLENCE.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Who sits in the empty chair?

lines.speaker: The Board
lines.text: THE EMPTY CHAIR SITS IN THE EMPTY CHAIR. IT VOTES LAST. IT VOTES ALWAYS.
The final elevator. A knight in plain, unsponsored armor holds the door.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: Room for one more? No cameras. No sponsors. I'm... self-funded now. Turns out confidence was the only qualification I ever had. Might as well aim it at something real.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Get in, Prestige.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Everyone we ever met is behind us. Everything we ever filed is in order. Hero... let's go review the CEO.
